_comment: #318 beat 3. ORIGINAL UNNAMED ARCHETYPE, never Ressa and never Reynold, and she never names her mistress -- the felt/seen rule (spec section 2). FOUR report arms, one per route counter (bought / handed over / lifted / taken), converge on `answered`, which carries the ONLY grant so the pay cannot double-fire. Exactly one is visible.

waiting.speaker: A Woman Who Came in a Carriage
waiting.text: Sit if you like. My waiting has nothing to do with you, or with this house. A question went out in her hand. When its answer exists, I will carry it back. Until then there is a fire here, and I intend to use it.

text_variants.text: You have something in your coat that is the wrong shape for a coat. Take the chair. Nobody in this house has ever once looked at what is on the table.

The card was answered, in her own hand, which was the answer. My mistress asked only whether the name was being sold or taken. It was being sold. That is a different letter to write and she has written it.

options._comment: The SOCIAL rung: he gave it up and asked to have it called destroyed; this player declined to.
options.text: "He handed it over himself. He wanted it called destroyed. It isn't."
"He never noticed it leave the table."
"He had two men. He has neither, and I have the block."

who.speaker: A Woman Who Came in a Carriage
who.text: A house sent me. You have been in this city long enough to know there is only one answer to that question worth giving and that nobody here gives it. I take a card out and I bring an answer back, and between those two things I sit somewhere warm and I am extremely dull.

options.text: "There's a lot of that trade in this city."

answered.speaker: A Woman Who Came in a Carriage
answered.text: Good. Then he was selling it, and nobody had to take it from him, and the lady kept enough of the name to be worth the theft. That will go back exactly as you said it and not one word further. She is paid for her trouble and you are paid for yours. My mistress does not do favours. She does accounts, and she settles them the same week.

effects.toast: Thirty gold, counted out flat on the table with no purse and no flourish, by a woman who has plainly never once had to check the count.
